Name: In a Giving Mood
Author: Gormageddon
Description: When within 2 squares of a villager, items in inventory and hotbar that are liked or loved gifts will be highlighted as such (Purple=loved, Green=Liked, Grey=Neutral, Orange=Dislike, Red= Hated). When hovering over an item, the image of villagers who like or love the itmem will appear. Villages that love the gift will appear with a heart.
